name: Industrial Production Technology
description: Industrial production technology programmes train the people who make production work better — process and layout, quality systems, lean methods, scheduling and inventory — usually alongside industrial engineers rather than on the machines themselves.
degreesNote: An associate degree, usually two years, and at several colleges a route into a bachelor's in engineering technology or operations. ⚠⚠ Read the occupation data before treating it as the finish line: 53% of O*NET's respondents said a BACHELOR'S degree is required for industrial engineering technician work and 29% an associate — the highest bachelor's expectation of any technician occupation on this site. ⚠ The individual courses are far more widely available than the degree, and several of them (quality assurance, lean and six sigma) are worth taking on their own account because they travel into every manufacturer.

cips.note: Industrial production technologies — 19 Florida public institutions, with 15.0613 (manufacturing technology) the main code at 15 of them and 80 credentials in 2023.

related.note: ⚠ The hands-on counterpart at the same colleges: this programme improves the process, that one keeps the machines running. Many students end up taking courses from both.
⚠ The four-year degree, and in this field it matters more than usual — over half of employers in the technician occupation ask for a bachelor's. Four Florida institutions award it.
The umbrella series — 76 institutions, and where the neighbouring branches of this family live.
